title: Keep the gold. Keep the quiet blues.
audio: Original sample-free sine/harmonic synthesis with authored scene accents; archived source audio muted.
source_scope: Actual same-source native photo exports; three combined adjustment choices; no single-control animation stands in for app response.
public_caption: Keep the gold. Keep the quiet blues. For this Nepal photograph I chose 5900 K, contrast+12%, and exposure+0.15 EV. The comparison shows the combined treatment, using actual Looksy PNG exports from the same source. Your photograph may need different choices. I’m building LOOKSi for photo and video, and I’d like the learning to feel approachable. What would you like to learn to change in your own photos?
alt_text: Keep the gold. Keep the quiet blues. Three small choices for this photograph.
